  <p class="ab-lede">Sisyphe builds AI for art, music and creative tools: agents that perceive a live environment and work inside it, whether that is a DAW, a stage, a gallery or an archive.</p>
</header>

<section class="ab-sec" id="what-we-do" aria-labelledby="what-we-do-h">
  <div class="ab-head">
    <span class="n">01</span>
    <h2 id="what-we-do-h">What Sisyphe does</h2>
    <p>A model that can see the whole environment and notice what changed is more useful than a chatbot beside it with a list of commands.</p>
  </div>

  <ol class="ab-log">
    <li>
      <span class="y">2023</span>
      <span class="k">Consulting</span>
      <p>Real-time conversational voice for Persona, music source separation advisory for Parts Order, fractional CTO for Tamada on an AI art curation engine for Visto.</p>
    </li>
    <li>
      <span class="y">2026</span>
      <span class="k">Products</span>
      <p><a href="projects.html#sideman">Sideman</a>, <a href="projects.html#kiln">Kiln</a> and <a href="projects.html#dandelion">Dandelion</a> followed. <a href="course.html">The course</a> teaches Sideman.</p>
    </li>
  </ol>

  <div class="ab-notes">
    <p>Sisyphe is independent of any employer. Client work never touches what the founder does at a day job, and the day job is not for hire here.</p>
  </div>
</section>
